credits_text:
Falling in love is beautiful... Finding love can be a nightmare
A FILM BY EDY O'S

DAVID LORENZO AND JESSICA HERRERA ARE IN THIS FILM ALONG WITH NICKY CARRERA, JANE COLEMAN, RACHEL EDWARDS, JENNIFER STEVENSON, AND DENISECRAIG WITH PELL PALMER, DAVE DAVIS, SPECIAL EFFECTS BY MIKE WILLIAMS, MAKE UP BY SHANNON HARRIS, POST PRODUCTION BY ALISON KIRK AND ERIC BRAZIL, CAN PRODUCTION PRACTICES, PRODUCER ERIN O'S, DIRECTOR EDY O'S
description: Poster features a red rose with a single drop of blood, accompanied by dramatic text about love and nightmares.
